A family evening to remember
Aug 2026 • Family
We just finished dinner ... a real delight! We ordered various dishes, they cleaned the fish for us and portioned it. Extreme grace and kindness, plus they advised us on the quantities. Another point of merit is their extreme honesty.. given the numerous portions ordered by our gluttonous family, they indicated the total amount to pay not only in local currency but also in euros! What can I say.. we will be back the day after tomorrow as soon as we are here again. Thanks to Tram who was always close to us, advising us and making our evening truly beautiful!
